newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips romp higher as Fed keeps rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips romp higher as Fed keeps rates steady.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks posted large gains Tuesday as the Federal Reserve's decision to keep interest rates unchanged suggested that the central bank was satisfied with the economy's performance.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 39.98 points at 6,308.33. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on active volume of 522 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
